# Agent-native session platforms

Dimension: tools purpose-built to host AI coding agents in a browser, self-hostable on
k8s. Key discriminator: does it run the **actual `claude` CLI** (with skills, hooks,
MCP, `~/.claude`), or its own agent loop? Sources: [`citations.md`](../citations.md)
[36]–[40].

## Scorecard

| Tool | License | Self-host k8s | Browser | Runs real `claude`? | Verdict | Cite |
|------|---------|---------------|---------|---------------------|---------|------|
| OpenHands | MIT (except `enterprise/`) | Enterprise VPC / Docker runtime | Yes | **No — own CodeAct agent** | Mismatch (its own agent) | [36] |
| Sculptor (Imbue) | OSS (repo exists) | **No — desktop (Mac/Linux)** | No (desktop) | Yes (Claude Code) | Right agent, wrong deploy | [38] |
| Anthropic self-hosted sandboxes | n/a (service) | Worker on your infra; **orchestration stays at Anthropic** | No | Managed-Agents tool exec, not `claude` CLI host | Not applicable | [37] |
| Claude Code on the web | n/a | **SaaS-only** | Yes | Yes | Not self-hostable | [39] |
| OpenHands Cloud (Helm) | Source-available | Enterprise k8s | Yes | No (own agent) | Not OSS / own agent | [40] |

## Findings

**OpenHands** is MIT "except for the `enterprise/` directory" but runs **its own agent**
("power it with Claude, GPT, or any other LLM") — it calls LLM APIs, it does not host
the `claude` CLI binary [36]. Docker-based runtime; k8s self-host is the enterprise VPC
path [36][40]. Disqualified for "host my Claude Code sessions" on the agent-mismatch.

**Sculptor (Imbue)** is the only surveyed tool confirmed to run actual Claude Code
("Claude Code is supported today", "every agent runs in its own container") — but it is
a **Mac/Linux desktop app** with no k8s/browser-server path [38]. Right agent, wrong
deployment model.

**Anthropic-official**: "self-hosted sandboxes" keep "orchestration on Anthropic's side
but move tool execution into infrastructure you control" via a worker polling Anthropic's
queue (providers: Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, Vercel) [37] — this is Managed-Agents tool
execution, not a self-hosted browser `claude` *session* host. "Claude Code on the web" is
Anthropic-managed cloud, not self-hostable [39].

**Multi-Claude orchestrators** (Conductor, Crystal/Nimbalyst, Claude Squad, Vibe Kanban):
discovery agents found these are predominantly desktop/terminal apps or community Docker
projects, several wrapping the real `claude` but none simultaneously OSS + k8s-self-host +
browser. (Snippet-level — not independently fetched.)

## Verdict

**No agent-native platform meets self-host-on-k8s + browser + runs-actual-`claude` + OSS
simultaneously.** The ones that run real Claude Code are desktop (Sculptor) or SaaS
(Claude Code on the web); the ones that are k8s/browser run their own agent (OpenHands).
This reinforces the build-custom conclusion: the most reliable way to host the *actual*
`claude` CLI in a browser on k8s is to put `claude` in a code-server pod yourself.

## Gaps / limitations

- The orchestrator landscape (Conductor/Crystal/Claude Squad/Vibe Kanban) is fast-moving
  and Snippet-level; verdicts there are lower-confidence.
- kube-foundry (k8s operator running `claude` per task) surfaced as task/batch-oriented,
  not interactive browser sessions — see [other-platforms](other-platforms.md) family.
